description: Frozen partition topology & maintenance contract (#93): REORGANIZE/ADD/COALESCE/PARTITION BY/REMOVE PARTITIONING plus CHECK/REBUILD/REPAIR/OPTIMIZE/IMPORT/DISCARD PARTITION as audited actions on the MySQL anchors, TiDB executing the five topology actions while the six maintenance ops stay 8200 vendor boundaries. Ordered state publishes proven member directories (names + bounds), refused operations keep exact pre-state, unproven outcomes unvouch only the affected member facts. Frozen rule IDs: warn-level governance for redistribution/rebuild ops, notice for CHECK, blocker for DISCARD; applicability/target rules carry dialect-correct native errors (1492/1493/1495/1505/1507/1508/1509/1517/1519/1520/1567/1735/1812/8200) and explicit evidence gaps never fabricate refusals — independent T14 acceptance contract
